verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any data-retention settings, deletion controls, account or space deletion, or AI-data retention policies for Capacities. The nearby items are adjacent features and earn no credit here: AI being opt-in (docs-16) governs data sharing, not retention or deletion, and full or scheduled exports (docs-11) are portability features. A REST API that can 'manipulate' content is only a developer building block.
